entries.note: The first step of every live history, also in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the order is created and the cargo is still to reach the sending terminal. Its short label is the same.
Seen live and listed in the tracker page's own script: the cargo is accepted at the sending terminal.
The short label the reply gives the same step for small screens.
Seen live and listed in the tracker page's own script: the cargo has left the sending terminal; the script says some routes skip this step.
The short label the reply gives the same step for small screens.

Seen live on routes collected at the terminal: the cargo is at the terminal in the consignee's city, ready to collect, where paid storage applies. On a route with delivery to an address or a pickup point the page's script says it is being prepared for that delivery and F3 follows, so the adapter keeps it in transit there.
The short label the reply gives the same step for small screens; staged by the route like its full wording.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): taken for delivery to the address or to a pickup point; only routes with delivery show it.
Seen live and listed in the tracker page's own script: issued to the consignee.
The short label the reply gives the same step for small screens.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the order is cancelled.
Heading of the tracker page's block shown when the sender has barred issue; the cargo keeps moving but is held at the destination until the sender lifts the bar.
